title: To remove the use restrictions on certain land transferred to Rockingham County, Virginia, and for other purposes.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the House passed version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 1) This bill declares that the approximately one-acre portion of specified land transferred by the United States to Rockingham County, Virginia, that is used for purposes of a child care center, shall not be subject to the use restriction imposed in the deed for the transferred land.

The bill eliminates the requirement that the county include information concerning the use of the transferred land for a child care center in biennial reports to the Department of the Interior.

summary.headline: A 2018 law frees about one acre of federally transferred land in Rockingham County, Virginia, from a deed rule that limited its use to a child care center.
summary.what_it_does: The law states that about one acre of land the federal government gave to Rockingham County, Virginia, is no longer bound by the deed's use restriction, even though a child care center operates there. It also removes the county's requirement to report child care center information in its biennial reports to the Department of the Interior.

who_it_affects.how: The county no longer has to follow the deed restriction on the roughly one-acre parcel and no longer has to include child care center information in its biennial reports to the Department of the Interior.

who_it_affects.group: Families who use the child care center on the parcel
who_it_affects.how: The center's current use of the land is no longer restricted by the original federal deed terms, though the summary does not describe any change to the center's services or operations.
It no longer receives child care center use information in the county's biennial reports for this parcel.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 12, 2018, and the official summary does not describe a separate later effective date.
